scheme.description: Account can be opened for girl child below 10 years of age by parent/guardian. Interest rate: 8.2% per annum, compounded yearly. Deposits for 15 years; account matures after 21 years from opening. Partial withdrawal permitted after girl attains 18 years for education (up to 50% of balance). EEE tax status (Section 80C deduction, tax-free interest, tax-free maturity). Maximum 2 accounts per family (exception for twins). Account can be opened at post offices and designated banks.
scheme.voice_summary: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a savings account for a girl child below 10 years, opened by a parent or guardian at a post office or bank.
eligibility: Must be resident Indian (NRI not eligible)
documents: Aadhaar / ID Proof of Parent / Legal Guardian
exceptions: Male children cannot open SSY accounts. Only girl child eligible.
Maximum of 2 accounts per family allowed, except in case of twin/triplet girl birth

faqs.question: When does a Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) account mature?
faqs.answer: An SSY account matures 21 years from the date of its opening or upon marriage of the girl child after attaining 18 years of age. Partial withdrawal up to 50% is allowed for higher education after age 18.
